notes.title: “Going Loud” - Combat Boss Build in Crime Boss: Rockay City
notes.content:
“Going Loud” - Combat Boss Build in Crime Boss: Rockay City

Hello! We’re back again with another Boss character build for Crime Boss: Rockay City!

In our previous post, we focused on stealth and infiltration. This included silenced weapons, equipment to help case the job, and perks designed to keep you out of sight while simultaneously ensuring no one escapes yours. You can check out the “Going Silent” build here:

505 Games » “Going silent” – Stealth Boss Build in Crime Boss: Rockay City

However, being a clandestine robber can sometimes be too slow, unnecessary, or straight-up impossible. For these missions and situations, professionalism must be thrown out the window in favor of a more “shock and awe” approach. Time to deal some damage!

As noted in the post above, these builds apply to your multiplayer boss and not necessarily for single-player heisters, though they can be used for inspiration. Let’s get into it!

Weapons
Primary: The Urban Striker

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/3f8587e20b11da9319cf18d509494b48c85644d9.png

Bottom of the barrel in terms of accuracy, ammo capacity, and reload time, but wait! Don’t brush it off yet because this drum-fed semi-auto shotgun packs a serious punch. Keep it loaded because, though this may sound counterintuitive, this will be acting as your secondary. When things get hot and the pressure is on, pull out the Striker and feel your worries wash away as you quickly dispatch large groups of opposing forces at once or deal massive damage to unique enemies like heavies and shields. If used effectively and accurately, it’s an extremely deadly weapon, especially in tight spaces.

Secondary: Glizzy R+

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/1b3f5701fa8682ea0adb7a8f87f56cb744f99a3d.png

The Glizzy R+ is a heavily modified version of its base counterpart. Sporting a red dot sight, compensator, and extended magazine, it can let off shots in rapid succession while maintaining relatively high accuracy. The damage output is low, but with the short reload time, enemies won’t have long before they’re back in your sights. This is a perfect sidearm when hauling loot—a full team with this weapon equipped might not even have to worry about dropping bags to switch to their primaries.

Equipment: Cluster Grenade

Exactly what it sounds like—a handheld cluster bomb! Throw it down a full corridor and see just how quickly it clears out, or put some arch in it and create a rudimentary air burst. Be careful though, these things can be unpredictable and potentially cause a lot of collateral damage—blowing up civilians, cars, or even you and your team.

Boss Perks
Perk 1: Gun Nut

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/06f46a7991738cd5f267aa39bb57255c94e0b8f8.png

The Gun Nut perk increases your overall weapon handling. Faster reloads, decreased weapon sway, the ability to reload while sprinting, and a slight damage buff will ensure that no matter how outmanned you are, the enemy will always be outgunned.

Perk 2: Marksman

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/b4ffae8069a836b472f4483b6806f9f03cd3326e.png

The Marksman perk gives your boss a further increase in firearm damage. It may not offer much, but what it does offer is substantial. With the combination of Marksman, Gun Nut, and the Urban Striker, you can expect most cops, gangsters, and guards to go down with little to no fight.

Perk 3: Comeback

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/f3b4c1d164912d6765d59ddae1dd3b9cc76c3639.png

As the primary damage dealer of your crew with this loadout, it’s important that you stay in the fight for as long as possible. The Comeback perk ensures you do, granting you an extra revive. Just make sure you bring someone reliable along to pick you up.

What’s Your Build?

If you want to suggest a build, improve on ours or want more of these in the future, join our discord or let us know our Steam suggestion sub-forum . See you in Rockay City!

Is Crime Boss: Rockay City a single player or multiplayer game?
Crime Boss: Rockay City is playable in single-player, either in the rogue-lite campaign or in offline mode with AI bots in the Multiplayer game modes. Or you can recruit a squad of your friends in 4 player co-operative PVE action.

Is Crime Boss: Rockay City a first-person shooter?

Crime Boss: Rockay City is not an open world game. You should expect to take on individual missions, ranging from smaller jobs and larger heists and you will have choices to go loud or remain stealthy.

You can play Crime Boss: Rockay City solo or as a team of 2, 3 or 4 and you can choose to fill any spaces in your team with AI bots if you want to. The more teammates you bring along, the higher your chances of successfully completing the mission.

notes.title: 10 THINGS TO KNOW ABOUT CRIME BOSS: ROCKAY CITY
notes.content:
Since Crime Boss: Rockay City will soon be releasing on Steam, June 18th, we expect a lot of new arrivals to Rockay City! Tackling this town can be a lot, so here is our list of 10 things to know when you play Crime Boss: Rockay City. 

1. Redefining the Genre 

When it comes to heisting games, there's nothing quite like Crime Boss: Rockay City. Combining heists with strategic gameplay and asset management is something you won’t find anywhere else. With dozens of different jobs, each with multiple variations, there is no shortage of opportunities in your criminal pursuits. Each and every one of these missions, of course, can be completed in the single-player campaign, Baker’s Battle, or with up to three friends in multiplayer PvE. 

2. Choices That Make or Break You 

In the single-player campaign, Baker’s Battle, your goal is to become the new underworld leader and be crowned ‘King’ of Rockay City. Along the way, certain actions will present different opportunities that can either help or hinder you. For example, you might be given the option to hand over the profits of your last major score to a rival gang leader. In return, they will leave the city, clearing the territory for you to take over— but only if you can get to it first. You might also choose to free an ally before they go in for questioning. However, should you fail, the evidence against you will be overwhelming, greatly speeding up the police investigation. There are many of these instances, so weigh your options carefully. 

3. Sheriff Norris' Investigation 

Enemy gangs and turf disputes are not the only things that you will need to contend with. Sheriff Norris has been tasked with taking back Rockay City from the dregs that are currently vying for power, and he’s starting with you. As you complete missions and take turfs, the heat will rise, resulting in a faster and more aggressive police presence when jobs go loud. This is reset at the start of each new day. However, as each day passes, the Sheriff’s investigation into your actions will progress. Should he complete his investigation before you are able to take over the city, you will be forced to flee. There are a few ways to slow down his investigation, which will be necessary on higher difficulties. You can bribe police, kill detectives, or free arrested crew members before they have time to be questioned. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/e1bb875a1622291ec725ca1c661c8a9eb5eeefec.jpg

4. Managing Your Crew 

There are dozens of different heisters to pick from to build your perfect crew. Some have their own unique backstories, but all of them have their own style and traits. There are three heister classes: the ‘Merc’, specializing in combat and dealing heavy damage; the ‘Thief’, perfect for infiltration and staying under the radar; and the ‘Brute’, able to take large amounts of damage while covering your escape. 

Then there are the ‘Legends,’ unique heisters that can be leveled up many times and sometimes brandish their own signature weapons. Finally, there’s the ‘Boss,’ able to run two jobs a day in the campaign and increase profits by fifty percent when taken on missions. However, if the boss dies, it’s game over. Any of the characters can gain experience on jobs and be promoted, which will award them new perks. 

Each job is different and will require different skills, so make sure you bring the right people for each heist. 

5. Keeping Quiet 

Most jobs can be completed entirely in stealth. Aside from just getting everyone out alive, there are multiple reasons why you might prefer to keep things quiet, including a slower investigation speed and higher returns on stolen goods. Be sure to select the crew members who will best avoid unwanted attention, and outfit them with silenced weapons and gear that preferably does not go BOOM. 

Keep a close eye on guards, cameras, and nosy civilians. Be mindful not to draw too much attention, the game works on an awareness system. Three strikes, and you’ll be forced to go loud. Trespassing, lockpicking, and doing suspicious activities like running or crouching in public areas will bring unwanted attention. 

6. Going Loud 

When being sneaky fails you, or the gig requires you to make a little noise, be prepared for a fight. Police are quick to respond, and depending on your standing in the city, they may bring out the big guns sooner rather than later. In these situations, especially on higher difficulties, you best hope you brought the right people and gear. 

Keep close to your team; the quicker you separate, the sooner you’ll each be picked off one by one. Stay in cover and make good use of the gear you brought, such as the C4 or the ‘berserk’ booster. If the Boss is on the team, he takes priority, even over the loot. When Travis Baker is out, the mission and your current campaign run is a wash. 

Remember, knowing when to cut your losses and retreat is vital. Replacing dead crew members costs more than leaving behind a few bags of loot. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/9e58d049e6ad31d3b8f98873ba1ff0f922478c9f.jpg

7. Deadly Turfwar 

There are plenty of rivals in the City of Rockay who want the crown as badly as you do. Get ready to attack their territories and defend yours in a gangland turf war. Hire soldiers to attack multiple turfs a day and send your toughest enforcer, Touchdown, to fend off any attacks. Upgrade your soldiers' equipment with cash or strike trade deals to give them the firepower they need to take on more challenging opposition. 

8. Alone or With Friends 

Experience Crime Boss your way, whether solo or with friends. Dive into the roguelite campaign, Baker’s Battle, on your own, or join one of three multiplayer co-op game modes. Engage in single-player heists with friends through standalone missions or use the shuffle feature for a randomized series of back-to-back heists. Multiplayer also features ‘Urban Legends,’ a narrative-driven mode where you and your friends select from pre-chosen heisters to tackle multiple jobs culminating in a major final score. Easily find servers or use the quick-join button to jump straight into the action. 

9. Progression 

As you progress through the game, whether in the roguelite campaign or multiplayer mode, you'll accumulate experience. With each level gained, you'll have the opportunity to choose one of three unlockable rewards. These may include new heisters, weapons, equipment, perks, and weapon skins. Some of these unlockables are exclusively available online, allowing you to craft your own criminal legend in Crime Boss multiplayer. 

There are dozens of weapons including melee, handguns, SMGs, rifles, shotguns, and LMGs as well as a wide array of equipment such as grenades, throwing knives, booster shots, sensor grenades, and more. Additionally, multiple perks that change the way you play, like the ‘Ghost’ perk which slows detection speed or ‘Toolkit’ which regenerates your equipment faster, are also available. As you level up, rarer weapons and equipment will become available for purchase, providing you with the extra firepower needed to tackle the more challenging heists on higher difficulties. Given that the game sees regular updates, you can be sure that your available stockpile will only continue to expand. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/3f30801c97b60fe3f99b35f54d1205524df35487.jpg

10. Craft Your Build 

In multiplayer, you can select from a diverse range of boss skins to tailor your appearance as a heist mastermind. Equip yourself with the finest weapons and gear and customize your firearms to set yourself apart from your crew. Strategically choose perks to optimize your boss and maintain clear communication with your team to improve your chances of success. As you progress and earn respect, observe how your surroundings evolve.

notes.title: WHY YOU SHOULD PICK UP CRIME BOSS: ROCKAY CITY
notes.content:
Crime Boss: Rockay City first released over a year ago on March 28th, 2023. Since then, 505 Games and the development team at InGame Studios have been working non-stop to craft and polish an exciting addition to the first-person heisting genre of games. As we fast approach the launch of Crime Boss on Steam along with our 9th major update, we want to highlight a few of the many things that make this game so great.

First of Its Kind

Crime Boss: Rockay City boasts many features that not only make it unique but also allow it to truly stand on its own. Set in the City of Rockay, inspired by 90s Miami, players will experience the art-deco cultural hub in the style of an over-the-top, action-filled crime fantasy. Playing with friends to pull off a variety of jobs, from national banks to simple gas station hold-ups, offers all manner of mischief to find yourself in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/4556d2b993f24fb1fc9e6442636aaa8df28511b0.png

Joining others and working together to steal the cash and level up your own unique boss in the online game modes is fun and rewarding. However, if you prefer to go at it alone, you can shoot, loot, and take over the town in the single-player roguelite campaign, Baker’s Battle. Play as Travis Baker and a host of other memorable characters as you engage in a vicious turf war against rival gangs while completing daring heists. Manage your crew, assets, and equipment while doing your best to avoid the law and Sheriff Norris' detectives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/7d19fb3dfc0019ff2c352ac9188e0b5c92abf919.png

There are many money-making opportunities and experiences to be had in Crime Boss, all of which can be experienced online or offline, whichever you prefer.

So Much More to Come

On June 18th, Crime Boss will finally make its long-awaited arrival on Steam. Releasing the game on the world’s largest PC gaming platform is a massive step in the right direction for the game and us, the developers. Along with the release comes our 2nd major DLC, ‘Cagnali’s Order,’ something that we are very proud of and excited for current and new players to get their hands on. This will allow us to gauge what people enjoy and what sort of content they would like to see in the future, of which we are not short of ideas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/57ec2184605fecbb79f57fbf0835afc7b204864c.png

Each previous update has brought new, refreshing features, including additional missions, weapons, playable characters, multiplayer game modes, a redesigned progression system, and more.

It is our mission to continue this trend of adding to and polishing the game. We always want players to be surprised (in a positive way) with each new update, and you can be sure that there’s a lot more in store for Crime Boss down the road.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/129be92f470f7ba8c268e15b825c82b64a3ee263.png

Our Growing Community

We owe a lot to our fans, new and old. Much of what has become of the game can be attributed to those who have learned the ins and outs of Crime Boss and come to us with fantastic suggestions. Over the course of the year, we have been very active with the players, talking through open Q&As, dev streams, and other media. The Crime Boss: Rockay City crowd is some of the best, and we invite you to join as well to talk with other players and even directly to the developers and the 505 team. notes.title: "GOING SILENT" - STEALTH BOSS BUILD IN CRIME BOSS: ROCKAY CITY
notes.content:
Hello everyone. We here at IGS and 505 Games want to give Crime Boss players our preferred boss builds to, hopefully, give you the edge on your next heist. 

This specific build is for those who prefer to take a stealthy approach. 

We should also specify that this suggested build applies to your multiplayer boss and not necessarily single player heisters, though it can be used for inspiration. We might make recommended crew setups for the campaign in a later post. 


Weapons 
Primary: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/b0ffc79d79ae550f2206506ae8c8276278bf6694.png

While it may not have the highest damage output compared to other primary weapons in the game, the TIMM 4 EOSG is hard to match. It has a high rate of fire while maintaining accuracy, even at longer distances. Sporting an impressive magazine size and a silencer, you’d be hard pressed to find a better longarm that can mow down enemies and keep the job quiet. 

Secondary: 

Dealing the most overall damage of any secondary weapon in the game, the Brescia 92 RS is a no brainer. Perfect for quickly and quietly dispatching any enemies and exactly what you need when your hands are full or don’t have the time to reload your primary. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/a5e58dbcbd9cf48571a7e2d7c76d7352bcdd819d.png

Equipment: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/aacd9f59cd6772d6a460bf8eebf20c9c29e3c186.png

The Sensor Grenade is an uncommon unlockable designed to outline and track the position of enemies, civilians, cameras, loot, and other items of interest. If you want to remain undetected, especially on higher difficulties, make sure you have this in your arsenal. 


Boss Perks 


Ghost

The Ghost perk decreases detection speed when doing suspicious activities like lockpicking or entering restricted areas. This applies to all NPC’s and cameras. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/132242c71a8e99a20d81e2d7cebc8e5c6b05acb4.png

Swift

Swift gives the player a speed buff even when carrying bags and allows you to reload while sprinting. If you need to get out of sight quickly, use this. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/ffcd0b6d7e829c98773307a5192f90700e2ec456.png

Toolkit

With Toolkit equipped, your throwables will recharge faster. With this and a sensor grenade, you can keep tabs on everyone and everything while on the job. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028972/86dd12de9aa24cae5de15212e022a2ef6d5ac02b.png

What’s Your Build? 

If you want to suggest a build, improve on ours or want more of these in the future, join our discord and let us know. See you in Rockay City!
